capabilities: Chat with and query your notes
Create or update notes from requests
Build custom plugins from natural-language descriptions
Iterate on built tools through conversation
disambiguation: Not just a notes chatbot; it also generates and activates standalone plugins you describe in conversation.
extras: Free under MIT license; connects directly to the AI provider with no server or tracking; API keys stay on-device and must be added per device; the plugin exceeds Obsidian Sync Standard's file size limit, so BRAT is recommended for multi-device installs; built-in dictation sends audio to OpenAI; generated plugins keep working if Superpowers is disabled.
problem: Creating custom Obsidian plugins normally requires coding, and the built-in assistant features don't act on or extend the vault.

relations.evidence: To try the beta, install BRAT from Community plugins

requires.name: OpenAI, Claude, or Gemini API key
API account with the chosen AI provider

summary: AI chat assistant that answers questions over your notes and builds small custom plugins from natural-language descriptions.
